articles.summary: NORWALK, Conn., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS), a leading global intelligence and AI solutions provider to the financial markets, today announced an expansion of its partnership with Scotia Wealth Management, part of the Scotiabank group of companies.
articles.title: FactSet Announces Expanded Partnership with Scotia Wealth Management
